title: synthesizability: data and code for 'Experimental Evaluation of High-Throughput Structure Predictions'
description: Data, analysis code and fits behind the paper Experimental Evaluation of High-Throughput Structure Predictions (arXiv:2611.09671): measured X-ray patterns of 34 arc-melted candidate compositions, the GSAS-II Rietveld fits shown in the Supplement with their exact commands and open-source starting structures, the search-match code (without ICDD PDF cards), database extracts, and the pipeline that rebuilds every table and figure.
